scope: Bounded source-text assertions from the Air Operations storage-bay heating-and-ventilating sequence of operation on MI743 (source PDF page 70). The source's copy-forward terminology is retained and not corrected to an inferred system description.
coordinate_system: Displayed PDF page, points, top-left origin; 2448 x 1584.

visual_review.finding: MI743 was visually reviewed at 180 DPI. The control diagram, point matrix and entire written sequence are present on one page.

sequence_scope.sequence_heading: 3.3.12 AIR OPS - STORAGE BAY HEATING & VENTILATING CONTROLS
sequence_scope.equipment: EF-A1, UH-A1 and UH-A2 control application

assertions.expected: WHEN ZN-T RISES ABOVE ZN-T-SP-HL (WITH A 2 DEGREES F DEADBAND), ENABLE THE VENTILATION COOLING CONTROL LOOP
WHEN ZN-T DROPS BELOW ZN-T-SP-LL (WITH A 3 DEGREES F DEADBAND), ENABLE THE HEATING CONTROL LOOP
FAILURE OF ANY PROOF OR ACTIVATION OF ANY SAFETY RESULT IN ALL CONTROL LOOPS BEING DISABLED AND THE FAN COIL UNIT FAN AND HUMIDIFIER BEING COMMANDED OFF UNTIL RESET
DDC HARDWARE RESET OF ALL PROOFS AND SAFETIES SHALL BE VIA A LOCAL BINARY PUSH-BUTTON (RST-BUT) INPUT TO THE DDC HARDWARE, VIA A REMOTE COMMAND TO THE DDC HARDWARE
ONCE THE DAMPER POSITION IS PROVEN OPEN, ENERGIZE EXHAUST FAN. WHEN THIS LOOP IS DISABLED, THE EXHAUST FAN SHALL BE DE-ENERGIZED AND THE AFTER A 15 SECOND DELAY BOTH THE OA AND EA DAMPER SHALL CLOSE
DDC HARDWARE SHALL ENERGIZE THE UNIT HEATER FANS AND MODULATE THE HHW VALVE TO MAINTAIN ZONE TEMPERATURE (ZN-T) AT SPACE LOW LIMIT SETPOINT (ZN-T-SP-LL) AS SHOWN
WHEN THIS LOOP IS DISABLED, THE UNIT HEATERS SHALL BE DE-ENERGIZED AND THE HHW VAVLES SHALL CLOSE

source_conflicts.finding: The written safety response refers to SUPPLY FAN, HUMIDIFIER and FAN COIL UNIT FAN even though the MI743 diagram/point matrix identify EF-A1 and unit heaters. The verbatim source statement is retained as evidence and is not reconciled into invented controls.
The written heating disable instruction spells HHW VAVLES. The source spelling is retained.

remaining_work: Reconcile the MI743 template to actual plan/schedule instances and continue full document controls, equipment, network, scale and sensor review.
